name: comp-354
title: Simple Tooltip
blurb: A button with a minimal text tooltip that appears immediately on hover.
description: Wraps a button in a TooltipProvider and Tooltip, showing simple text content on hover. No delay before tooltip appears.
use_when: Standard UI tooltips for buttons that need light context or labels.
avoid_when: Complex tooltip content; use a more feature-rich component instead.
a11y: Button is fully accessible; tooltip is shown via hover only, not keyboard-accessible.
